Covering Virtual Soccer, Virtual Basketball, Virtual Horse Racing, Virtual Greyhounds, Virtual Speedway, Virtual Motorsports, Virtual Cycling, Virtual Tennis and Saba Soccer for PES and FIFA 20.

lbl_Esport_desc: Offering markets on every major matchup in the E-Sports arena, players can bet on CS GO, Dota 2, League of Legends, King of Glory, PUBG, Starcraft 2 and other popular titles
lbl_Mobile_Betting_desc: IvorySport's mobile H5 and Native App are intuitive and easy to use. Players can access IvorySport website on their mobile browser or download our native app in Apple iTunes or Google Playstore. iOS and Android apps are both optimized to fulfill players enjoyment.
lbl_Open_An_Account_desc: Open an account with IvorySport is fast and easy. Enjoy a wide variety of promotion and bonuses whenever you make a deposit. Be a IvorySport VIP and enjoy more rewards.
